comment: Pinned Gradle wrapper provenance for D5. tools/validate/validate.sh recomputes the wrapper jar digest and cross-checks gradle-wrapper.properties against this file. Every checksum here was fetched from gradle.org, never hand-written.
howTheJarWasProduced: The verified gradle-9.5.1-bin.zip was extracted and its own `gradle wrapper` task generated gradle/wrapper/. The resulting gradle-wrapper.jar digest equals the wrapper jar checksum Gradle publishes for 9.5.1, so the committed jar is byte-identical to the upstream artifact rather than merely plausible.
